players.product: etch (ICP / CCP), PVD / CVD / ALD / epitaxy deposition, vertical-furnace thermal, wet clean and ion implant tools for 3D NAND, DRAM and logic fabs

quarterly_data.signal: Precision components: NAURA's high power-density power modules and high-precision analog chips entered the data-center supply chain; high power-density point-of-load power supplies for AI and data-center use are shipping in growing volume.

Precision components: affected by industry competition, downstream price pass-through and other factors, the segment's profitability showed a certain downward trend; the company says it keeps working to improve it through expansion of higher value-added products, process-efficiency gains and cost control.
